Need Page
Fix installation, skill, OAuth, or API failures Troubleshooting
Understand safe-use and current-release boundaries Security and capability boundaries
Check releases or report an issue Releases and feedback

Start with evidence

tts_open_toolkit version
tts_open_toolkit doctor
tts_open_toolkit auth doctor --json
tts_open_toolkit skill state --scope project --json

Include the safe command output, operating system, Node version, intended task, actual result, and reproduction steps when asking for help. Remove credentials before sharing.

Send feedback

Use the English form to report a problem, request a capability, or tell us where the documentation was unclear. TTS Open Toolkit Feedback Form
